title:
Epic triggered on `PAGE_TITLE_ACTION_CLICK_VALIDATE_AND_PREVIEW` actions to display banners based on the
`expression` entered.
There are three different workflows that this epic handles:
1. When the user haven't entered any expression.
   - It will display a banner to enter an expression.
   - Stop the chart spinner, that is shown when the user clicks on the preview button.
   - Merge the arguments to the empty ´dynamicComponentDataSourceId' passed to the payload.
   - Reset dates on the filter panel, to be empty.
2. When the user have entered an invalid expression.
   - It will display a banner with the error message. And what might be the issue.
   - Stop the chart spinner, that is shown when the user clicks on the preview button.
   - Merge the arguments to the empty ´dynamicComponentDataSourceId' passed to the payload.
   - Reset dates on the filter panel, to be empty.
3. When the user have entered a valid expression.
   - It will display a banner with the success message.
   - Merge the arguments to the default ´dynamicComponentDataSourceId' passed to the payload.
   - Make the data request to the server to get the preview chart data.
   - Set {@link MetricConfigApplicationState#isExpressionValid} to true, because only valid expressions
    can be used to create or update a metric.
   - Save the current chart spec to the application state, so that it can be used to plot the preview chart.
name: ValidateReliabilityMetricExpressionEpic
